author: nerfgun2002
body:
So, a while back around 1 month ago I got banned from Avicus, the obvious reason is "Ban Evading" which was not quite through because "BryanHuen" was not my account. Anyways I took BryanHuen's account and played on the build server and for some reason I was immature at night at started griefing the build server. I am really sorry for all this "Drama" and I didn't obviously used hacks although it was the same IP as me. I regretted griefing that night and I am truly sorry for causing those trouble. I hope I can get unbanned. RIP nerfgun2002.

-nerfgun2002
